label: runtime/cli/doctor.sh (read-only health check, catches the install-time silent-skip-deps failure, doctor.sh:2-3) has ZERO references anywhere (rg over .opencode + .github, docs included: none outside itself); the /doctor command implements its own machinery (commands/doctor/scripts/doctor-runtime-bootstrap.sh); absent from both registries and the README. Recommendation: remove, or merge its silent-skip-deps check into the /doctor bootstrap.

The .scan* seven (.scan-one.sh, .scan-validate-all.sh, .scan-results.txt [0 bytes], .scan-lines.txt, .scan-validate-all.txt, .no-frontmatter-list.txt, .enumerate-no-frontmatter.py) have zero references and zero documentation; they one-off duplicate what tests/test-validation.sh + spec/validate.sh already provide. Recommendation: remove the seven (the README-omission aspect is already filed as f-iter001-005).

Two one-off scripts survive on changelog memories: migrate-deep-research-paths.ts (7.0KB, sole reference: changelog/v3.0.0.3.md) and seed-council-value-fixture.cjs (3.3KB, references: 2 deep-ai-council changelogs + 1 benchmark report) — no wired caller, no current documentation, no registry entry. Recommendation: remove both.

The twin-module pattern — same basename, different directory, drifting role: core/alignment-validator.ts (227L, extracted from workflow.ts, imported by workflow.ts:98) vs spec-folder/alignment-validator.ts (712L, imported by spec-folder/index.ts:20 + folder-detector.ts:27-28), both production-wired with disjoint concerns; joined by the scorer twins (core/quality-scorer.ts 0-caller vs the extractors/ canonical) and a third suspect pair (utils/phase-classifier vs lib/phase-classifier, 5 citations, spelling split caller-not-fully-verified); the one sanctioned non-twin is the documented inversion seam cli/config/index.ts:5-8. The cost is realized: a test exists to disambiguate the scorers. Recommendation: document the ownership boundary (which directory owns which concern).

Two more documented-but-unwired root entries, extending f-iter002-007: deploy-mcp.sh (README:111, the declared canonical rebuild step; references: itself + 1 fixture string + 1 changelog) and test-council-matrix.sh (README:113; references: 2 changelogs + 1 historical benchmark report) — no wired caller in any of the five surfaces or workflows. Recommendation: document their unwired status alongside the six already recorded, or wire deploy-mcp into the 046-series worktree setup.
